description: Reads one page and checks the title and description lengths, canonical, meta robots, lang, Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type) and the X card, and whether og:image loads as an image of a sensible size. Returns a score out of 100, the tags as found and findings with fixes. Counts against the free daily limit unless cached.

url.description: The page to check, for example store.com/products/blue-shirt

name: check_meta_tags
title: Check the title, meta description and Open Graph tags of a page
